summary: Multi-bit field setter. Writes a value into the 15-bit window (bits 15-29) of the 32-bit word at this+0x30: the word is cleared with mask 0xFFC07FFF, a2 shifted by 15 is ORed in, and the result is stored and returned.

operations.description: Read the current 32-bit word at this+0x30 as the base value.
Clear the 15-bit window (bits 15-29) of the current word: this[12] & 0xFFC07FFF.
Shift a2 into the cleared window: a2 << 15.
Combine the shifted value with the cleared word: (a2 << 15) | (this[12] & 0xFFC07FFF).
Store the combined result into this[12].

unresolved: Meaning of the 15-bit value a2 (which lighting/render parameter it encodes) is caller-supplied and unknown.
Whether bits 0-14 and 30-31 of +0x30 carry independent flags is not established here.
